reason: Structural CD19 location: defaultPathOperations/pathOperationsFor confines Node path and file-URL conversion behind named string-only PathOperations. Reviewer consumers use this existing adapter; no platform types are exported. The additional module-location capability is a deliberate reviewer-port paydown boundary decision.

Structural CD19 location: defaultSidecarFileReader/defaultFileKindPort/defaultFileTextPort confines filesystem and temporary-directory runtime access. Review scripts and hermetic fixtures consume named text/file capabilities with production factories; no Node file/stat types are exported. Adding writes and temporary scratch lifecycle here reuses the existing filesystem boundary instead of opening a second Node fs wrapping site.

Structural CD19 location: defaultReviewProcessPort is the deliberate process boundary for reviewer entrypoints and hermetic subprocess fixtures. It confines Node child execution, environment, standard streams and termination; consumers receive string/status data and named capabilities, never ChildProcess or stream types.

Deliberate CD19 wrapping site for the ESLint-compatible CD14 plugin protocol, used by ESLint and Oxlint. ESLint and Rule types stay at the callback/registration boundary; configuration consumers receive the owned ClassAuthoringPlugin model. The co-located test is the explicit native-protocol test boundary: its RuleTester import exercises that RuleModule with real JS and TypeScript ASTs, as required by the approved review scope. Why-chain: 1. Native class-syntax enforcement needs the engines' plugin protocol. 2. That protocol supplies AST callbacks and diagnostic reporting. 3. Typing those callbacks requires the external eslint types, including type-only imports. 4. Keeping the translation and registration in this single file confines that dependency instead of spreading vendor types into consumers. 5. Root decision: retain one explicit native-engine boundary for the approved CD14 fragment slice; the diagnostic-port design remains Helen's separate open judgment (PR34 review5530609166).
